rules.message: reads inside the repository are allowed at any rung
this command deletes a tree with no rollback handle; stage the change in a git worktree and rerun, or declare a rollback on the capability
a shared write at the assisted rung needs a human approval; request one with gantry approve, naming the capability
an irreversible effect runs only at the led rung; ask the operator to run this step directly
this call is outside the capability set granted at subagent.spawn; widen the grant at spawn time or drop the call
a credential value appears in a tool argument; pass the handle instead and let the broker substitute at the boundary
